channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Patrick Beverley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Patrick Beverley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Draymond Green on the Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley:

“D-Wade comes back and he’s like, I don’t understand why Patrick Beverley would say anything like that you ain’t good enough to talk about me. I like how D-Wade popped his sh*t, I respect it I’m not getting in the middle of those two brothers. You know, that’s a Chicago thing you let them do there thing. But, I will say Pat Bev coming out and throwing that three point percentage out, was hilarious. Well Pat Bev the defense was guarding y’all a lil bit different brotha.”

Draymond Green on Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley, Mar 31, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“I think Patrick [Beverley] is the ultimate competitor... His podcast is great... I'm looking forward to the opportunity to play against him as always.”

Kyle Lowry on Patrick Beverley, Feb 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
DeMar DeRozan on Patrick Beverley:

“He’s an elite competitor. And it’s hard to find guys who compete at such an elite level.”

DeMar DeRozan on Patrick Beverley, Feb 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Deandre Ayton on a suspension probably coming for Patrick Beverley and how he didn't get involved:

“They're not gonna get me there. Me, it's like I got Monty Williams to answer to at the end of the day. I ain't want him to be disappointed in me for doing that nonsense like that.”

Deandre Ayton on Monty Williams, Patrick Beverley, Nov 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @KellanOlson.

item.title: Chris Finch on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Chris Finch on Patrick Beverley:

“Pat just does a good job of keeping everyone kind of on edge in the locker room and around the building and anywhere in a 6-county radius. We loved him for that.”

Chris Finch on Patrick Beverley, Oct 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the relationship he still has with Patrick Beverley:

“That's my big brother, man. I love Pat. I'm gonna see him tonight. That's my dog.”

Anthony Edwards on Patrick Beverley, Oct 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Darvin Ham on Patrick Beverley:

“I think he’s going to be a lovely addition to our ball club and a great tone setter… you heard him mention the grit, the grind, just being a dog out there.”

Darvin Ham on Patrick Beverley, Sep 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“We are thrilled to add Patrick Beverley’s toughness and competitive spirit to our team,”

Rob Pelinka on Patrick Beverley, Aug 25, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“We’re confident that Patrick’s ‘3-and-D’ style will fit in nicely with the other pieces of our roster,and align perfectly with Coach Ham’s philosophy of hard work and smart play.”

Rob Pelinka on Patrick Beverley, Aug 25, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jarred Vanderbilt on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Jarred Vanderbilt on new @Utah Jazz guard Patrick Beverley:

“He was one of our vocal leaders last year, always good to have that veteran presence,especially with a young team that we had. So he brings a lot to the team that doesn't show up in stats.”

Jarred Vanderbilt on Patrick Beverley, Jul 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Malik Beasley on new @Utah Jazz teammate Patrick Beverley:

“You've got to listen to him because he knows the game. A lot of people don't know he's made the playoffs every single year he's played in the NBA.”

Malik Beasley on Patrick Beverley, Jul 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Paul George on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Farbod Esnaashari:Paul George on Patrick Beverley's antics:

“It's all for show. It's for the crowd. I love it. I miss it, he doing it on our side. Because it's contagious.”

Paul George on Patrick Beverley, Apr 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Doc Rivers on why Patrick Beverley wins everywhere he goes:

“Because he's crazy as hell. He's one of my favorite guys. He's literally crazy, in a positive way... He'll do some crazy things on the floor that'll drive you nuts as a coach, and his answer is 'I'm just tryin to win'”

Doc Rivers on Patrick Beverley, Feb 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Ty Lue on Patrick Beverley:

“We got a quiet team by nature. And Pat was the guy that kind of kept us ramped up and kept guys engaged with his voice and talking and communicating. He's a huge part of what we did last year.”

Tyronn Lue on Patrick Beverley, Nov 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Chris Finch on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“It gives our defense a bit of a personality. Defenses are always best when they start on the ball with the type of approach and aggressiveness he brings. I think one of the most encouraging things about bringing Patrick here is not how excited we are he's coming, but he's really excited. He knows he's exactly the type of piece we need.”

Chris Finch on Patrick Beverley, Sep 1, 2021. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris
item.description:
Terance Mann says hello -- and goodbye for 2020-21:

“Everybody had a hand in my development this season, from top to bottom fro Pat Beverley to Rondo to PG to Kawhi to Serge ... Marcus Morris was a big help.”

Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Michele Roberts on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Michele Roberts:

“I don’t really want to comment on the Patrick thing. What happens in our meetings should stay in our meetings. But players have the responsibility to understand the consequences of their actions with respect to the business. And this is a business. This is how they make their living. Some of them are fortunate to be able to do this for 15 or 20 years. But most of them are not. Most of them have an average of less than five years in the league, and those will likely be their best revenue-generating years. So I’ve got to make sure that they understand what they’re doing, how much it will cost and what’s the impact.”

Michele Roberts on Patrick Beverley, Sep 11, 2020. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Michael Malone on Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Michael Malone on Pat Beverley's comments on the difficulties of defending Nikola:

“I don't listen to Patrick Beverley a whole lot. If Kawhi Leonard was talking, I might listen. Kawhi's a great player.”

Michael Malone on Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard, Sep 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Michael Malone on Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Mike Malone on Patrick Beverley’s flailing comments about Nikola Jokic:

“I don’t listen to Patrick Beverley a whole lot. If Kawhi Leonard was talking, maybe I would listen to it. Kawhi’s a great player. ...They shot 26 free throws, we shot 10.”

Michael Malone on Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard, Nikola Jokic, Sep 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul George, Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Mike Malone on Pat Bev playing:

“He's a very good defender, we all know that. Applies tremendous ball pressure. Last time we played them, in LA, Patrick Beverley-Paul George-Kawhi Leonard, three elite defenders on the perimeter and they all took turns guarding Jamal Murray.”

Michael Malone on Paul George, Patrick Beverley, Kawhi Leonard, Jamal Murray, Sep 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Paul George, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Blazers’Damian Lillard on Clippers’ celebrating & waving him off court after clutch FT misses:

“Patrick Beverley, I sent him home before. Paul George just got sent home by me last year... I’m not offended by it. It should tell you how much it hurt them.”

Damian Lillard on Paul George, Patrick Beverley, Aug 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“Every time I play against Russ, I say something back. Same thing with Pat Beverley,”

Damian Lillard on Patrick Beverley, Jan 29, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: James Harden on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Harden on Pat Beverley's defense:

“It's always great to compete against him. We all know what Pat does. He's great and he'll try to get in your head. If you let him get into your head and get into your body, he can be a pest.”

James Harden on Patrick Beverley, Nov 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Louis Williams on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Lou Williams on the dynamics of the Clippers' locker room changing with the additions of Kawhi and PG:

“I don't know if there's a way to tell Pat Beverley to chill out.”

Louis Williams on Patrick Beverley, Sep 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Thibodeau told The Athletic.

“I think it’ll be seamless. You’re talking about two elite defenders that guard multiple positions, multiple effort guys, never quit on plays. Both guys are very unique. Even if you can get by them, they’ll come from behind and get the ball. “I think when you add in Patrick Beverley on the ball, 94 feet, and then those guys up in passing lanes, it’ll be very hard to score against them.”

Tom Thibodeau on Patrick Beverley, Jul 7, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Patrick Beverley, Draymond Green
item.description:
“You know Beverley's going to flop, and Draymond turned; it looked like Tyson punched him in the face.”

Steve Kerr on Patrick Beverley, Draymond Green, Apr 25, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
“When I get the ball in my spots, I have a pest, Patrick Beverley, who is up underneath me,”

Kevin Durant on Patrick Beverley, Apr 18, 2019. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“I'm not going to get in the way of the game because I want to have a little back-and-forth with Patrick Beverley. I'm Kevin Durant. You know who I am. Ya'll know who I am.”

Kevin Durant on Patrick Beverley, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kevin Durant, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Beverley and Durant getting ejected last night:

“Seeing the highlights from last night, I’m not sure anybody deserved to get kicked out of the game. I didn’t think it was that bad.”

Steve Kerr on Kevin Durant, Patrick Beverley, Apr 14, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Coach D'Antoni on @Patrick Beverley:

“Oh yeah, Pat is probably one of my favorite guys I've ever coached. Just tough, gritty, got an edge to him. You know he's going to compete and he's going to under people's skin and he's going to come at you. The guy's a winner....”

Mike D'Antoni on Patrick Beverley, Apr 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.
